name: City Harbour & Docks
description: Stone quay, a timber gangway and one large moored sailing ship.
palette: wet grey cobble, weathered oak, tarred rope brown, murky green harbour water
lighting: overcast maritime daylight, damp reflective stone, soft lantern accents
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, carefully shaded volumetric detail, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: wet grey cobblestone paving with tar stains, rope scuffs and standing puddles
materials: A fantasy city harbour district seen from above. A heavy stone quay of worn wet cobbles with iron mooring bollards, a large moored wooden sailing ship floating on the water with a planked deck, hatches, coiled rigging and a capstan, a timber gangway running from the deck onto the quay, stacked cargo crates, barrels, fishing nets and rope coils along the dock, roofless timber-and-plaster dockside warehouses seen from above, their plank floors packed with cargo, tar stains and puddles on the stone, dark green harbour water.
boundary: open harbour water on one side and the flat rooftops of warehouses on the others
